sources.entry: Xmind Copilot - AI mind map and one-click slide generation. #free

summary.name: Xmind
summary.one_liner: Xmind is a mind mapping and brainstorming tool with an AI agent that turns ideas, files, images, or links into editable mind maps.
use_cases: turning notes, files or links into a mind map
planning project next steps with due dates
presenting a mind map as a video
building editable maps from ChatGPT conversations
summary.what_it_does: Xmind Agent takes a starting idea, file, image, or link and organizes it into a mind map showing key points and how they connect. It can convert ideas into next steps, showing order, due dates, and project progress. Mind maps can be shared as a video, with custom images and stickers added to illustrate points. The page also lists integrations: a ChatGPT plugin for creating and editing maps inside ChatGPT, an MCP server that lets compatible AI tools create and update maps in an Xmind workspace, and Xmind Skills & CLI that let agents create, read, edit, and validate native local Xmind files.
notable: AI agent that builds mind maps from ideas, files, images, or links
ChatGPT plugin and MCP server for AI tool integration
Xmind Skills & CLI for agents to read and write native Xmind files
Share mind maps as presentation videos
caveats: Pricing and paid tiers are not stated on the page
Platform support beyond the web and ChatGPT is not listed on the page text
Listing notes Xmind Copilot as free, but the page text itself does not confirm free access
